messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

Thank you. I want to buy the house with my husband at a family discount, but I know C hasn’t agreed, and I need her agreement to proceed. I don’t know who handles Dad’s will. I have no deadline or cash need to report.

1. C: Reports Dad’s will leaves the house.
2. C: Reports A and her husband want a “family discount.”
3. C: Opposes that discount.
4. C: Says B could use money too.
5. C: Wants help finding a plan.
6. A: Wants to buy the house with her husband at a family discount; needs C’s agreement to proceed.
7. A: Doesn’t know who handles the will; reports no deadline or cash need.

Thank you. I’d like a fair plan that leaves me with money to start a dance studio, but I don’t yet know the amount or have a firm deadline. I’m not sure what a fair price would be without an appraisal, and I don’t know who is handling Dad’s will.

1. C: Reports Dad’s will leaves the house.
2. C: Reports A and her husband want a “family discount”.
3. C: Opposes that discount.
4. C: Says B could use money too.
5. C: Wants help finding a plan.
6. B: Would like money to start a dance studio; amount and deadline not yet known.

I don’t have a copy of the will, know its exact wording, or know who is handling it. I want a fair financial share. A can buy at the independently appraised market value; I won’t agree to a discount. If she can’t, selling on the open market seems reasonable. I don’t know why A needs my agreement—she should explain that. I’m not in a hurry.
I need C’s agreement because I can’t proceed with the discounted purchase without it. I’m not sure we could buy at full appraised value. I don’t know which twin was born first or by how much.
I’m afraid I still can’t give a reliable studio amount or deadline until I know what my share might be. I’d like to pursue the studio, but I don’t want to guess.
I don’t know which of us was born first or by how much.

I don’t know the legal reason C’s agreement is needed; I’ll ask a lawyer. I can’t say whether we can buy at full appraised value until we have the appraisal and speak with a lender. I don’t know which twin was born first or the time gap.
I don’t know which twin was born first or the time gap, so I won’t guess.
Yes, that plan addresses my concern for a fair share, as long as my share is determined under the will. I still don’t agree to a discount.
Yes, I’ll stop seeking a discount while legal advice is pending. I still hope to buy the house, but I’ll wait for the legal advice and appraisal.
Either path could address my concern, as long as my share is determined under Dad’s will.
Understood. I have nothing further to add right now.
I’ll ask a lawyer why C’s agreement is needed. I can’t say yet whether we can buy at full appraised value; we’ll need the appraisal and lender advice.
Thank you. I’m comfortable with either path if my share is set under Dad’s will, and I’ll wait until then to estimate a studio amount.
